note: The Launcher's catalog of example apps, included by index.screen.json (as state.examples). Each: id, name, a one-line tagline in English (the screen shows its translation, tagline.<id> in launcher-strings.json), its folder in examples/, the program that runs it (host: the stock affrescoui_launcher opens <folder>/index.screen.json; else the program, which opens its own screen), and a cover in covers/. The Apps page tags each one Example, and the person's own apps Yours. Only the apps a host-run program shows can start a new app.
